title: The Two Essences and the Building of the Firmaments as a Palace
description: From the original duality of Light and Darkness, through the mingling and crucifixion of the First Man's emanations, the Living Spirit and Mother of Life raise up the firmaments as an architect builds a palace, shaping raw and unworked stones and wood into vessels of glory. When the Third Ambassador comes, the wise are taken up while Error and Darkness are gathered inward and cast to the Deep.
